title: build(deps): bump @supabase/supabase-js from 2.112.4 to 2.115.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. @supabase/supabase-js 2.112.4 -> 2.115.0 in packages/client. The only upstream change of note is postgrest adding getOpenApiSpec(); no code in this repository calls it, and nothing in the client was changed to adopt it. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001) -- the point of the friction is the lockfile audit recorded in behavior_change below.
behavior_change: none. Lockfile audited against merge-base d59de10f by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry, not by reading the truncated diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly six entries changed version, all of them the @supabase family moving 2.112.4 -> 2.115.0 in lockstep: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js, supabase-js. Zero packages added, zero removed, and zero non-@supabase entries touched. This is the check that PR #296 failed -- a supabase bump that also silently reverted zod 4 to 3 -- so it was run as an enumeration rather than an eyeball.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range `@supabase/supabase-js` from ^2.112.4 to ^2.115.0 -- one line, no other dependency touched. packages/client/package-lock.json resolves that range, moving the six @supabase packages listed in behavior_change to 2.115.0. There are no incidental version movements: the added/removed/changed sets outside @supabase are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff, and nine manifests written for other dependency work would each have covered these two files -- borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 exists to refuse.
